explanation: Large, flat stones that were used to build an altar and memorials according to God's instructions.
A sacred structure where offerings and prayers were given to God as part of the ancient Israelite cult system.
God's instructions and commandments given to Moses and the people of Israel to guide their lives and society.
A positive statement or action from God that brings prosperity, happiness, and protection to the recipient.
A negative statement or action from God that brings misfortune, suffering, and punishment to the recipient.
The twelve groups of the people of Israel descended from Jacob's twelve sons.
A subgroup of the Levites, one of the twelve tribes of Israel, who had specific duties in the tabernacle and later in the temple.
